feature: The emergency card as an Apple Wallet pass (front)
description: NOT a capture: a reconstruction of the pass front. The fields, labels, colours and images are exactly what the production pass code (veyagocloud supabase/functions/_shared/wallet-pass.ts buildPassJson, run read-only on the app's sample card) puts in pass.json (wallet-pass.pass.json beside it); the layout imitates Wallet's generic pass template and the type is DM Sans standing in for SF Pro. 370 x 300 pt at 3x, transparent outside the 14 pt corner radius. Background rgb(180,35,24) #B42318, values white, labels rgb(255,220,214); logo = white Star of Life + logoText Emergency card; header BLOOD TYPE A+; primary BORN 1946 / Eleanor Hughes; secondary ALLERGIES Penicillin, Shellfish; thumbnail = the 90 pt Star of Life sign plate; auxiliary IN AN EMERGENCY, CALL David Hughes and SON (614) 555-0133 right-aligned; no barcode. The pass art PNGs are in wallet-pass-art/.
howCaptured: node --experimental-strip-types tools/capture/wallet-pass/build-pass.mjs; node tools/capture/wallet-pass/render-pass.mjs (HTML -> Remotion's chrome-headless-shell over CDP, cdp-shot.mjs)
